evidence.approach: Attempt 8 fixes F1 from the attempt 7 review (return 115, scope note 116), Ruud's decision. Attempts 6 and 7's two slices stand as delivered; this attempt adds one slice. mutation.source_files keeps a path under packages/core/src only when it is product source Stryker can mutate: a .ts file, or an entry whose last segment has no extension, which is a directory (packages/core/src itself, or a directory under it). Anything else, such as a .json schedule or a .md beside the code, is not held to the floor, exactly as mutation_ci.select already ignores it. The rule lives in one private predicate in harness/mutation.py (_mutable), applied inside source_files after under_test maps a test to its source, so the gate (gates.plan_source_files and _require_mutation) and CI (select calls source_files) read the same rule from one place. select keeps its own .ts filter, because a changed path from git diff is always a file and an extensionless changed file is not a directory; with source_files filtering too, the two now agree on every path the gate can see. patterns and command are unchanged: they only ever receive what source_files kept. F4 (the ticket's summary table says Status doing) is fixed with the attempt 8 Outcome before review; F2 and F3 are noted only (Ruud's decision, record 116).
changes: harness/mutation.py: a _mutable(path) predicate (a .ts file, or an entry whose last segment carries no extension) applied in source_files; the docstrings of source_files and patterns say a data file under src is not product source and is not measured.

harness/tests/test_mutation.py: SourceFilesTest gains a .json under src alone (nothing), and beside a .ts file (only the .ts); a gate test that a slice naming fee.ts and schedules.json is measured over fee.ts alone and advances on a measurement of it.
docs/tickets/SEEN-116-property-based-and-mutation-tests-on-the-money.md: the attempt 8 Outcome, the summary table's Status row (F4), status review and the criteria ticked before the review gate.
tests_first: python3 -m unittest harness.tests.test_mutation: source_files(['packages/core/src/fees/schedules.json'], everything_exists) returns []; source_files(['packages/core/src/fees/fee.ts', 'packages/core/src/fees/schedules.json'], everything_exists) returns ['packages/core/src/fees/fee.ts']; a tdd gate whose slice names both, with a measurement over fee.ts at or above the floor, advances. RED: today the json is returned as an entry, so the first two assertions fail and the gate refuses with the json missing from the measurement.

slices.name: A data file under src is not product source, in the gate as in CI
slices.red: source_files over a slice naming packages/core/src/fees/schedules.json, alone or beside fee.ts, keeps the json as an entry, so the gate demands a measurement of a file Stryker can never mutate, while select ignores it.

alternatives: Drop the .ts filter from select and let source_files decide alone: rejected, a changed extensionless file would then be read as a directory by CI; select's filter costs nothing and the two agree on every path a slice can name.

Refuse a slice that names a non-.ts file under src at solution: rejected, a data file beside the code it configures is a legitimate thing for a slice to change, and the floor is about mutable source, not about which files a slice may touch.
Defer F1 to a follow-up ticket: rejected by Ruud's decision at record 116.
risks: An extensionless file under src (a LICENSE, say) is read as a directory and expands to the .ts files under a path that holds none, so the gate refuses it as missing: no such file exists under packages/core/src today, select never sends it to CI, and the refusal names the path, so it is a plan to amend rather than a silent pass.
A slice that changes only a data file under src is now held to no floor: that is the point, Stryker cannot mutate data; the tests that read the data still run in the regression.
evidence.rollback: Revert the attempt 8 commit; source_files returns to keeping every path under src, which only re-adds the refusal F1 describes, with no data to migrate.
